synopsis: Alban realizes that he had been reincarnated as the “villainous nobleman” of a fantasy novel. Just as he starts rigorously training in sword and sorcery so that he would not be defeated by the hero, Alban finds out that Leticia, the daughter of the villain, is to be his bride! Leticia is a young lady who is the subject of many unsavory rumors! He was scared to see what kind of “bad girl” she would be… But when he meets her, she seems pure and beautiful as an angel, almost like his ideal woman. Alban is so smitten that he forgets all about his plan to avoid the bad ending. He decides to strike back at the mastermind behind his beloved wife's downfall! Using their own villainous reputation to their advantage, he sets a trap to lure out the culprit......? (Source: Corona EX, translated)

synopsis: In the Lapland region of Finland, the domain of snow, midnight sun, and auroras, there is the small Hotel Metsäpeura, run by two older gentlemen. One night during a terrible blizzard, a mysterious young man named Jun arrives at the hotel. He is clearly in dire straits, with a large tattoo on his back, no relatives and no money. title: Osu! Karate Club

synopsis: Matsushita Tadashi is a second year student at Kangokou High School (in Osaka, Japan) and a constant target of Kangokou's numerous bullies who beat him up routinely after school. He is accompanied by his best friend Saitou Takaki, who is also constantly harassed. As the pair grow increasingly tired of being victimized they decide to join the titular Karate Club, which is notorious throughout Osaka's youth gangs for training and producing the city's most hardened and toughest teenage thugs while maintaining the facade of a legit school sports club. But when they join the club, they find themselves picked on just as much if not worse by the club's current members.

synopsis: The story of a possessed person in a book who will not hesitate to kill for her goal. Brinny, who lived in obedience to her stepfather, thought it had nothing to do with her. Until she got involved in an incident with the sickly second prince, Lucian. At a moment of crisis, Brinny used her supernatural powers to save Lucian, and was relieved that everything was resolved when she saw that the possessed person, 'Aridna', was captured. However, for some reason, her beloved sister and the first prince died in a carriage accident, and even Lucian, who became her fiancé, began to act strangely. Wasn't the possessed person executed in the past? Is 'Aridna' still alive? Brinny decides to reclaim the empty space left by the disappearance of her precious people. She will fight the possessed person. (Source: Kakaopage, translated)
